experiment_data.hypothesis: SFT baseline: supervised finetuning on FOLIO data (500 steps, Qwen3-4B, same model as all GRPO experiments) to establish whether hacking patterns are GRPO-specific or general finetuning artifacts. r4: fix CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES + --gpu + --no_wandb.
